_comment: Written against the output of `stuff --help` (Stuff CLI, Sept 2026).
Commands and flags taken straight from its documented examples:
stuff add list "Launch Plan" --space Work --tag Client
Entries marked UNVERIFIED below are not in that help output; run
`stuff_import.py --validate` to have the CLI itself confirm or reject

_unverified.task.--heading: not in the help output; add heading exists, but no documented way to file a task under one
_unverified.task.--space: not documented for add task; needed for Things to-dos that sit in an area with no project
_unverified.task.--notes: --notes is documented for add space only
_unverified.list.--plan / list.--deadline: --deadline is documented for edit list, not add list
_unverified.tags_style: --tag is singular in every example; repeating it is an assumption
_unverified.when_map.someday: --plan takes a date in every example; 'someday' as a value is a guess
_unverified.repeats: no repeat/recurrence flag appears anywhere in the CLI
